carry: Interim, until this lands: app_push.sh run from a clean worktree checked out at the pull request's exact head, with the corrected body and no new commit, should push nothing and PATCH the body (read from the code, never yet run). Its first real test is the first block at an unchanged head whose repair is body-only; at revision 4 that is #2561 (carry-missing at 1019d18d), unless #2559's merge clears its bad destinations first. Run --dry-run, then live, and confirm the head sha unchanged.
Pre-study: the Lean flow pre-study, section K14.
brief: Repair a pull request's body without moving its head (Lean flow study K14; expedite, it repairs the line). Ruling R4 forbids moving a clean head, and update_pr.sh merges main on every run, but no tool PATCHes a body alone: app_push.sh mints, pushes, then PATCHes, and has no body-only flag. Bodies that pr-contract or carry_audit refuse therefore stay red or get a head move. (#2560's 111 to 113 figure, cited in revision 3, was not a live case: the live body already said 113 from the round-3 recount; corrected in revision 4.) Add one seat instrument that takes a pull request number, the expected head sha and a body file; refuses unless the live head equals the expected sha; runs the body contract offline at that head (the policy_lint.mjs --pr-body arm prepr runs, and carry_audit.py check --body); PATCHes the body as the hpo-author App through the same mint app_push.sh uses, factored out rather than copied; reads the body back byte-identical; and re-reads the head to show it did not move. pr-contract re-runs on the edited event. Controls: a fixture where the head moved refuses before any write; a body the contract refuses is never sent; a dry-run prints the exact request; mutants for the head check, the contract arm and the read-back. Revision 8: run only the body contract, never the full prepr (the interim dry run through app_push.sh costs about 3 min because prepr runs; target under 30 s); and run carry_audit.py with --roster-ref naming the freshly fetched round roster branch, because an offline check reads the roster from the worktree and passes a carry that is not on the roster branch, which only fix-review step 10 would catch.
